verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right (sale ribbon, then a dominant headline, then a strong CTA), but it drops the product can and the Solstice logo, the red ribbon is crammed tiny into the top-left corner, and the legal line under the headline can't be read. B keeps the product and logo, but it puts a 4-line block of legal text at the far left where it competes with the headline as a second focal point, and it shrinks the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon to a tiny strip under the headline, so the left side looks cluttered and the hierarchy is muddled.
